name: Mangalorean Tea
description: The Mangalorean Tea is a herbal drink made of dry-roasted and coarsely powdered spices. The spices are boiled with water and sweetened with misri. A little bit of milk is added to the herbal concoction to balance the flavour and strength and make it pleasant to the palate. Apart from having a general rejuvenating effect,this caffeine free herbal tea also help to soothe the throat.
